content.value: Define a structure "Employee" with employee-name, department, salary, and a (16) nested structure "Address" with house-no and postal-code.
(i) Write a C program to input details for 3 employees, including the address from the console. Use loops to store and display all employee details with their address.
(ii) Write a function 'getAvgSalary(Employee[])' which takes an array of employee structure as input and outputs the average salary of those employees.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2023
